tr.t: Walmart nihayet Apple Pay ve Google Pay'i kabul ediyor
tr.d: ABD'nin en büyük perakendecisi yıl sonuna kadar mağazalarında mobil cüzdan ödemelerini açıyor.
tr.body:
Walmart, bu yılın sonuna kadar ABD mağazalarında Apple Pay ve Google Pay ile ödeme kabul etmeye başlayacak. Perakende devi yıllardır kendi Walmart Pay çözümünü öne çıkararak bu iki yaygın cüzdana kapalı kalmıştı. Mobil temassız ödemenin standart hâline geldiği bir dönemde bu adım, kasadaki sürtünmeyi azaltıp müşteri beklentisini karşılamayı hedefliyor.

Kaynak: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

en.t: Walmart will finally accept Apple Pay and Google Pay
en.d: The largest U.S. retailer opens its stores to mobile-wallet payments by year-end.
en.body:
Walmart will start accepting Apple Pay and Google Pay in its U.S. stores by the end of this year. The retail giant had long held out, pushing its own Walmart Pay instead of the two ubiquitous wallets. With mobile contactless payment now standard, the move aims to cut checkout friction and meet shopper expectations.

Source: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

de.t: Walmart akzeptiert endlich Apple Pay und Google Pay
de.d: Der größte US-Händler öffnet seine Filialen bis Jahresende für Mobile-Wallet-Zahlungen.
de.body:
Walmart wird bis Ende dieses Jahres in seinen US-Filialen Apple Pay und Google Pay akzeptieren. Der Handelsriese hatte sich lange gesperrt und stattdessen sein eigenes Walmart Pay forciert. Da kontaktloses mobiles Bezahlen inzwischen Standard ist, soll der Schritt Reibung an der Kasse verringern und Kundenerwartungen erfüllen.

Quelle: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

fr.t: Walmart va enfin accepter Apple Pay et Google Pay
fr.d: Le premier détaillant américain ouvre ses magasins aux paiements par portefeuille mobile d'ici la fin de l'année.
fr.body:
Walmart commencera à accepter Apple Pay et Google Pay dans ses magasins américains d'ici la fin de l'année. Le géant de la distribution avait longtemps résisté en imposant son propre Walmart Pay plutôt que ces deux portefeuilles très répandus. Alors que le paiement mobile sans contact est devenu la norme, cette décision vise à réduire les frictions en caisse et à répondre aux attentes des clients.

Source : https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

es.t: Walmart por fin aceptará Apple Pay y Google Pay
es.d: El mayor minorista de EE. UU. abre sus tiendas a los pagos con billetera móvil antes de fin de año.
es.body:
Walmart empezará a aceptar Apple Pay y Google Pay en sus tiendas de EE. UU. antes de que termine el año. El gigante del comercio se había resistido durante años, impulsando su propio Walmart Pay en lugar de estas dos billeteras tan extendidas. Con el pago móvil sin contacto ya convertido en estándar, la medida busca reducir la fricción en la caja y responder a las expectativas de los clientes.

Fuente: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

it.t: Walmart accetterà finalmente Apple Pay e Google Pay
it.d: Il più grande rivenditore degli Stati Uniti apre i suoi negozi ai pagamenti con wallet mobile entro fine anno.
it.body:
Walmart inizierà ad accettare Apple Pay e Google Pay nei suoi negozi statunitensi entro la fine dell'anno. Il colosso del retail aveva a lungo resistito, spingendo il proprio Walmart Pay invece dei due wallet ormai diffusissimi. Ora che il pagamento mobile contactless è lo standard, la mossa punta a ridurre gli attriti alla cassa e a soddisfare le aspettative dei clienti.

Fonte: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-finally-starts-supporting-apple-pay-and-google-pay/

tr.t: Amazon dron teslimatını 5 yeni şehre taşıyor
tr.d: Prime Air; Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse ve Boise'de devreye giriyor.
tr.body:
Amazon, Prime Air dron teslimat hizmetini beş yeni ABD metropolüne genişletiyor: Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta ve Boise. Şirket, yıl içinde daha fazla bölgenin ekleneceğini duyurdu. Hızlı teslimatın rekabetin merkezinde olduğu bir dönemde dron ağı, son kilometre lojistiğini ölçeklerken maliyet ve hız dengesini yeniden çiziyor.

Kaynak: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

en.t: Amazon expands drone delivery to five more U.S. metros
en.d: Prime Air heads to Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse and Boise.
en.body:
Amazon is expanding its Prime Air drone delivery to five more U.S. metro areas: Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta and Boise. The company said more communities will follow later in the year. With fast delivery central to competition, the drone network reshapes the balance of cost and speed as last-mile logistics scale up.

Source: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

de.t: Amazon weitet Drohnenlieferung auf fünf weitere US-Metropolen aus
de.d: Prime Air kommt nach Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse und Boise.
de.body:
Amazon weitet seine Prime-Air-Drohnenlieferung auf fünf weitere US-Ballungsräume aus: Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta und Boise. Weitere Orte sollen im Laufe des Jahres folgen, so das Unternehmen. Da schnelle Lieferung im Wettbewerb entscheidend ist, verschiebt das Drohnennetz das Verhältnis von Kosten und Tempo, während die Logistik auf der letzten Meile skaliert.

Quelle: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

fr.t: Amazon étend la livraison par drone à cinq nouvelles métropoles américaines
fr.d: Prime Air arrive à Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse et Boise.
fr.body:
Amazon étend sa livraison par drone Prime Air à cinq nouvelles zones métropolitaines américaines : Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta et Boise. L'entreprise indique que d'autres localités suivront plus tard dans l'année. Alors que la rapidité de livraison est au cœur de la concurrence, le réseau de drones redessine l'équilibre entre coût et vitesse à mesure que la logistique du dernier kilomètre monte en puissance.

Source : https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

es.t: Amazon amplía la entrega con drones a cinco metrópolis más de EE. UU.
es.d: Prime Air llega a Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse y Boise.
es.body:
Amazon está ampliando su entrega con drones Prime Air a cinco áreas metropolitanas más de EE. UU.: Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta y Boise. La compañía señaló que más comunidades se sumarán a lo largo del año. Con la entrega rápida en el centro de la competencia, la red de drones redibuja el equilibrio entre coste y velocidad a medida que escala la logística de última milla.

Fuente: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

it.t: Amazon estende la consegna con droni ad altre cinque metropoli USA
it.d: Prime Air arriva a Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Syracuse e Boise.
it.body:
Amazon sta estendendo la consegna con droni Prime Air ad altre cinque aree metropolitane statunitensi: Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta e Boise. L'azienda ha dichiarato che altre località seguiranno nel corso dell'anno. Con la consegna rapida al centro della competizione, la rete di droni ridisegna l'equilibrio tra costo e velocità mentre la logistica dell'ultimo miglio cresce di scala.

Fonte: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/21/amazon-drone-delivery-expansion-summer-2026/

tr.t: Walmart, Q4 için satıcı takvimini ve WFS son tarihlerini açıkladı
tr.d: Perakende devi, Kara Cuma ve yılbaşı sezonu için üç bölümlü başarı rehberi ve kritik tarihleri yayımladı.
tr.body:
Walmart, dördüncü çeyrek için satıcılarına yönelik üç bölümlü bir 'tatil başarı rehberi' ve Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) son teslim tarihlerini paylaştı. Henüz ağustos olmasına rağmen Kara Cuma ve yılbaşı hazırlığının şimdiden başladığını hatırlatan platform, stok ve gönderi planlaması için net tarihler verdi. Erken planlama, sezon içi stok tükenmelerini ve gecikmeleri önlemeyi amaçlıyor.

Kaynak: https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

en.t: Walmart lays out Q4 seller calendar and WFS deadlines
en.d: The retailer published a three-part holiday success guide and key dates for Black Friday and Christmas.
en.body:
Walmart has shared a three-part 'holiday success guide' for sellers and the delivery deadlines for Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) ahead of Q4. Though it is still August, the platform stressed that Black Friday and Christmas preparation starts now, giving concrete dates for inventory and shipment planning. Early planning aims to avoid in-season stockouts and delays.

Source: https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

de.t: Walmart legt Q4-Verkäuferkalender und WFS-Fristen fest
de.d: Der Händler veröffentlichte einen dreiteiligen Feiertags-Leitfaden und wichtige Termine für Black Friday und Weihnachten.
de.body:
Walmart hat einen dreiteiligen 'Feiertags-Erfolgsleitfaden' für Verkäufer sowie die Lieferfristen für Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) für das vierte Quartal veröffentlicht. Obwohl es erst August ist, betont die Plattform, dass die Vorbereitung auf Black Friday und Weihnachten jetzt beginnt, und nennt konkrete Termine für Bestands- und Versandplanung. Frühe Planung soll Lieferengpässe und Verzögerungen in der Saison vermeiden.

Quelle: https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

fr.t: Walmart détaille le calendrier vendeur du T4 et les délais WFS
fr.d: Le détaillant publie un guide de réussite des fêtes en trois parties et les dates clés pour Black Friday et Noël.
fr.body:
Walmart a communiqué un « guide de réussite des fêtes » en trois parties pour les vendeurs ainsi que les délais de livraison de Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) avant le T4. Bien qu'on soit encore en août, la plateforme souligne que la préparation du Black Friday et de Noël commence dès maintenant, avec des dates précises pour la planification des stocks et des expéditions. Une planification anticipée vise à éviter les ruptures et les retards en pleine saison.

Source : https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

es.t: Walmart detalla el calendario de vendedores del Q4 y los plazos de WFS
es.d: El minorista publicó una guía de éxito navideño en tres partes y fechas clave para Black Friday y Navidad.
es.body:
Walmart ha compartido una 'guía de éxito navideño' en tres partes para vendedores y los plazos de entrega de Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) de cara al Q4. Aunque todavía es agosto, la plataforma subraya que la preparación para Black Friday y Navidad empieza ya, con fechas concretas para planificar inventario y envíos. La planificación anticipada busca evitar roturas de stock y retrasos en plena temporada.

Fuente: https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

it.t: Walmart definisce il calendario venditori del Q4 e le scadenze WFS
it.d: Il rivenditore pubblica una guida al successo delle feste in tre parti e le date chiave per Black Friday e Natale.
it.body:
Walmart ha condiviso una 'guida al successo delle feste' in tre parti per i venditori e le scadenze di consegna di Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) in vista del Q4. Pur essendo ancora agosto, la piattaforma sottolinea che la preparazione a Black Friday e Natale inizia ora, con date precise per la pianificazione di scorte e spedizioni. Una pianificazione anticipata mira a evitare esaurimenti e ritardi in piena stagione.

Fonte: https://channelx.world/2026/08/walmart-three-part-holiday-success-guide-and-key-wfs-deadlines/

tr.t: Yankee Candle İngiltere'de TikTok Shop'a açıldı
tr.d: Ev kokusu markası, sosyal ticaret platformunda doğrudan satışa geçti.
tr.body:
Yankee Candle, İngiltere'de resmî olarak TikTok Shop'ta satışa başladı; müşteriler artık ürünleri doğrudan platform içinden keşfedip satın alabiliyor. Hamle, markanın dijital perakende stratejisinde önemli bir adım ve hızla büyüyen sosyal ticaret kanalına yönelişini gösteriyor. TikTok Shop, keşif ile satın almayı tek akışta birleştirerek markalara yeni bir doğrudan-tüketici kanalı sunuyor.

Kaynak: https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

en.t: Yankee Candle launches on TikTok Shop in the UK
en.d: The home-fragrance brand moves to direct selling on the social-commerce platform.
en.body:
Yankee Candle has officially launched on TikTok Shop in the UK, letting customers discover and buy its products directly within the platform. The move is a notable step in the brand's digital retail strategy and its shift toward the fast-growing social-commerce channel. TikTok Shop merges discovery and purchase in a single flow, giving brands a new direct-to-consumer route.

Source: https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

de.t: Yankee Candle startet im TikTok Shop in Großbritannien
de.d: Die Duftmarke geht auf der Social-Commerce-Plattform zum Direktverkauf über.
de.body:
Yankee Candle ist offiziell im TikTok Shop in Großbritannien gestartet und lässt Kundinnen und Kunden Produkte direkt auf der Plattform entdecken und kaufen. Der Schritt ist ein wichtiger Teil der digitalen Handelsstrategie der Marke und zeigt ihre Hinwendung zum schnell wachsenden Social-Commerce-Kanal. TikTok Shop verbindet Entdeckung und Kauf in einem Fluss und eröffnet Marken einen neuen Direktvertriebsweg.

Quelle: https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

fr.t: Yankee Candle se lance sur TikTok Shop au Royaume-Uni
fr.d: La marque de parfums d'intérieur passe à la vente directe sur la plateforme de social commerce.
fr.body:
Yankee Candle s'est officiellement lancée sur TikTok Shop au Royaume-Uni, permettant aux clients de découvrir et d'acheter ses produits directement sur la plateforme. Cette décision marque une étape importante de la stratégie de vente numérique de la marque et son virage vers le social commerce en forte croissance. TikTok Shop réunit découverte et achat dans un même parcours, offrant aux marques un nouveau canal direct au consommateur.

Source : https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

es.t: Yankee Candle se lanza en TikTok Shop en el Reino Unido
es.d: La marca de fragancias para el hogar pasa a la venta directa en la plataforma de social commerce.
es.body:
Yankee Candle se ha lanzado oficialmente en TikTok Shop en el Reino Unido, permitiendo a los clientes descubrir y comprar sus productos directamente en la plataforma. La medida es un paso relevante en la estrategia de venta digital de la marca y en su giro hacia el social commerce, de rápido crecimiento. TikTok Shop une descubrimiento y compra en un mismo flujo, ofreciendo a las marcas un nuevo canal directo al consumidor.

Fuente: https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

it.t: Yankee Candle debutta su TikTok Shop nel Regno Unito
it.d: Il marchio di fragranze per la casa passa alla vendita diretta sulla piattaforma di social commerce.
it.body:
Yankee Candle ha ufficialmente debuttato su TikTok Shop nel Regno Unito, permettendo ai clienti di scoprire e acquistare i suoi prodotti direttamente sulla piattaforma. La mossa è un passo importante nella strategia di vendita digitale del marchio e nel suo spostamento verso il social commerce in rapida crescita. TikTok Shop unisce scoperta e acquisto in un unico flusso, offrendo ai brand un nuovo canale diretto al consumatore.

Fonte: https://channelx.world/2026/08/yankee-candle-expands-uk-retail-strategy-with-tiktok-shop-launch/

tr.t: Yeni sıralama: Yapay zekâ en çok hangi perakendecilere yarıyor?
tr.d: AI Commerce Rankings, çevrimiçi mağazaların yapay zekâ kanallarındaki görünürlüğünü ölçüyor.
tr.body:
Digital Commerce 360 ve ReFiBuy'ın temmuzda başlattığı AI Commerce Rankings, yapay zekâdan en çok fayda sağlayan çevrimiçi perakendecileri ortaya koyuyor. Sıralama yalnızca markaların yapay zekâ kanallarında ne kadar görünür olduğuna değil, bu kanallarda ne kadar iyi performans gösterdiğine de bakıyor. Yapay zekânın alışveriş keşfini yeniden şekillendirdiği bir dönemde bu tür ölçümler, markaların yeni görünürlük savaşını anlamasına yardımcı oluyor.

Kaynak: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

en.t: New ranking tracks which retailers AI is helping the most
en.d: The AI Commerce Rankings measure online stores' visibility across AI channels.
en.body:
The AI Commerce Rankings, launched in July by Digital Commerce 360 and ReFiBuy, reveal which online retailers are getting the most help from artificial intelligence. The ranking looks not only at how visible brands are in AI channels but also at how well they perform there. As AI reshapes product discovery, such measures help brands understand the new contest for visibility.

Source: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

de.t: Neues Ranking zeigt, welchen Händlern KI am meisten hilft
de.d: Die AI Commerce Rankings messen die Sichtbarkeit von Onlineshops in KI-Kanälen.
de.body:
Die im Juli von Digital Commerce 360 und ReFiBuy gestarteten AI Commerce Rankings zeigen, welche Onlinehändler am meisten von künstlicher Intelligenz profitieren. Das Ranking betrachtet nicht nur, wie sichtbar Marken in KI-Kanälen sind, sondern auch, wie gut sie dort abschneiden. Da KI die Produktsuche verändert, helfen solche Kennzahlen Marken, den neuen Wettbewerb um Sichtbarkeit zu verstehen.

Quelle: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

fr.t: Un nouveau classement mesure les détaillants les plus aidés par l'IA
fr.d: Les AI Commerce Rankings évaluent la visibilité des boutiques en ligne dans les canaux d'IA.
fr.body:
Lancés en juillet par Digital Commerce 360 et ReFiBuy, les AI Commerce Rankings révèlent quels détaillants en ligne profitent le plus de l'intelligence artificielle. Le classement examine non seulement la visibilité des marques dans les canaux d'IA, mais aussi leur performance sur ces canaux. Alors que l'IA transforme la découverte de produits, ces mesures aident les marques à comprendre la nouvelle bataille de la visibilité.

Source : https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

es.t: Un nuevo ranking mide a qué minoristas ayuda más la IA
es.d: Los AI Commerce Rankings evalúan la visibilidad de las tiendas online en los canales de IA.
es.body:
Los AI Commerce Rankings, lanzados en julio por Digital Commerce 360 y ReFiBuy, revelan qué minoristas online obtienen más ayuda de la inteligencia artificial. El ranking no solo analiza la visibilidad de las marcas en los canales de IA, sino también su desempeño en ellos. A medida que la IA transforma el descubrimiento de productos, estas métricas ayudan a las marcas a entender la nueva batalla por la visibilidad.

Fuente: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

it.t: Una nuova classifica misura quali rivenditori l'IA aiuta di più
it.d: Gli AI Commerce Rankings valutano la visibilità dei negozi online nei canali di IA.
it.body:
Gli AI Commerce Rankings, lanciati a luglio da Digital Commerce 360 e ReFiBuy, rivelano quali rivenditori online ottengono più aiuto dall'intelligenza artificiale. La classifica considera non solo quanto i brand siano visibili nei canali di IA, ma anche quanto vi performino bene. Mentre l'IA trasforma la scoperta dei prodotti, queste misure aiutano i brand a capire la nuova sfida per la visibilità.

Fonte: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/20/ecommerce-trends-which-online-retailers-ai-is-helping-the-most/

tr.t: Walmart'ın veri platformu Scintilla, Sam's Club'a genişliyor
tr.d: Marka ve satıcılar, üye davranışını anlamak ve öngörmek için Walmart'ın analiz platformunu kullanabilecek.
tr.body:
Walmart, Scintilla veri analizi platformunu Sam's Club'a genişletiyor. Sam's Club satıcıları ve markaları, üye davranışını daha iyi anlamak ve tahmin etmek için platformu kullanabilecek. Hamle, perakende medya ve birinci taraf veriye dayalı satıcı araçlarının büyüyen önemini gösteriyor.

Kaynak: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

en.t: Walmart extends its Scintilla data platform to Sam's Club
en.d: Merchants and brands will be able to use it to understand and predict member behavior.
en.body:
Walmart is extending its Scintilla data-analytics platform to Sam's Club. Sam's Club merchants and brands will be able to use it to better understand and predict member behavior. The move underscores the growing importance of retail media and first-party-data tools for sellers.

Source: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

de.t: Walmart weitet seine Datenplattform Scintilla auf Sam's Club aus
de.d: Händler und Marken können damit das Verhalten der Mitglieder verstehen und vorhersagen.
de.body:
Walmart weitet seine Datenanalyse-Plattform Scintilla auf Sam's Club aus. Händler und Marken von Sam's Club können damit das Verhalten der Mitglieder besser verstehen und vorhersagen. Der Schritt unterstreicht die wachsende Bedeutung von Retail Media und First-Party-Daten-Tools für Verkäufer.

Quelle: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

fr.t: Walmart étend sa plateforme de données Scintilla à Sam's Club
fr.d: Les marchands et les marques pourront s'en servir pour comprendre et anticiper le comportement des membres.
fr.body:
Walmart étend sa plateforme d'analyse de données Scintilla à Sam's Club. Les marchands et les marques de Sam's Club pourront l'utiliser pour mieux comprendre et anticiper le comportement des membres. Ce mouvement souligne l'importance croissante du retail media et des outils fondés sur les données first-party pour les vendeurs.

Source : https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

es.t: Walmart amplía su plataforma de datos Scintilla a Sam's Club
es.d: Comercios y marcas podrán usarla para entender y predecir el comportamiento de los socios.
es.body:
Walmart está ampliando su plataforma de análisis de datos Scintilla a Sam's Club. Los comercios y marcas de Sam's Club podrán usarla para entender y predecir mejor el comportamiento de los socios. El movimiento subraya la creciente importancia del retail media y de las herramientas basadas en datos propios para los vendedores.

Fuente: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

it.t: Walmart estende la sua piattaforma dati Scintilla a Sam's Club
it.d: Commercianti e brand potranno usarla per capire e prevedere il comportamento dei soci.
it.body:
Walmart sta estendendo la sua piattaforma di analisi dati Scintilla a Sam's Club. I commercianti e i brand di Sam's Club potranno usarla per capire e prevedere meglio il comportamento dei soci. La mossa sottolinea la crescente importanza del retail media e degli strumenti basati sui dati proprietari per i venditori.

Fonte: https://www.modernretail.co/technology/walmart-extends-scintilla-data-platform-to-sams-club/

tr.t: Glass, kamu tedarik pazaryerine yapay zekâ özellikleri getirdi
tr.d: Şirket, devlet kurumlarının kullandığı G-Commerce pazaryerini yapay zekâ yenilikleriyle yeniden konumlandırıyor.
tr.body:
Kamu tedarikine odaklanan teknoloji şirketi Glass, pazaryeri G-Commerce için birden fazla yapay zekâ özelliğini kamuya açtı. Şirket, hamleyi devlet kurumları için G-Commerce'in yeniden tanıtımı olarak konumlandırıyor. Gelişme, B2G (işletmeden kamuya) e-ticaretinde yapay zekânın artan rolüne işaret ediyor.

Kaynak: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

en.t: Glass brings AI features to its government procurement marketplace
en.d: The company is relaunching its G-Commerce marketplace for government agencies with AI upgrades.
en.body:
Glass, a government-procurement technology company, has publicly released multiple AI features for G-Commerce, its marketplace. The company frames the move as a reintroduction of G-Commerce for the government agencies that use it. The development points to AI's growing role in business-to-government (B2G) e-commerce.

Source: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

de.t: Glass bringt KI-Funktionen auf seinen Beschaffungs-Marktplatz für Behörden
de.d: Das Unternehmen relauncht seinen Marktplatz G-Commerce für Behörden mit KI-Erweiterungen.
de.body:
Glass, ein Technologieunternehmen für die öffentliche Beschaffung, hat mehrere KI-Funktionen für seinen Marktplatz G-Commerce veröffentlicht. Das Unternehmen versteht den Schritt als Neueinführung von G-Commerce für die nutzenden Behörden. Die Entwicklung verweist auf die wachsende Rolle von KI im B2G-E-Commerce (Business-to-Government).

Quelle: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

fr.t: Glass apporte des fonctions IA à sa place de marché d'achats publics
fr.d: L'entreprise relance sa place de marché G-Commerce pour les administrations avec des nouveautés IA.
fr.body:
Glass, entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les achats publics, a rendu publiques plusieurs fonctions d'IA pour sa place de marché G-Commerce. L'entreprise présente cette étape comme une réintroduction de G-Commerce pour les administrations qui l'utilisent. Cette évolution illustre le rôle croissant de l'IA dans l'e-commerce B2G (business-to-government).

Source : https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

es.t: Glass lleva funciones de IA a su marketplace de compras públicas
es.d: La empresa relanza su marketplace G-Commerce para organismos públicos con mejoras de IA.
es.body:
Glass, una empresa de tecnología para compras públicas, ha lanzado públicamente varias funciones de IA para G-Commerce, su marketplace. La compañía presenta el paso como una reintroducción de G-Commerce para los organismos que lo usan. El avance apunta al creciente papel de la IA en el e-commerce B2G (empresa a gobierno).

Fuente: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

it.t: Glass porta funzioni IA nel suo marketplace per gli acquisti pubblici
it.d: L'azienda rilancia il marketplace G-Commerce per gli enti pubblici con novità basate sull'IA.
it.body:
Glass, azienda tecnologica specializzata negli acquisti pubblici, ha reso pubbliche diverse funzioni di IA per G-Commerce, il suo marketplace. L'azienda presenta la mossa come una reintroduzione di G-Commerce per gli enti pubblici che lo utilizzano. Lo sviluppo evidenzia il ruolo crescente dell'IA nell'e-commerce B2G (business-to-government).

Fonte: https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/19/glass-ai-upgrades-government-procurement-marketplace/

tr.t: Amazon, yapay zekâyla özel ürün tasarlamayı uygulamasına ekledi
tr.d: Alışveriş uygulamasındaki yeni özellik, Alexa ile üretilen tasarımları tişört ve benzeri ürünlere basıyor.
tr.body:
Amazon, Alışveriş uygulamasına yapay zekâyla özel ürün tasarlama özelliği ekledi. Kullanıcılar Alexa üzerinden görsel tasarımlar üretip bunları tişört, kapüşonlu ve termos gibi ürünlere bastırabiliyor. Özellik, kişiselleştirmeyi doğrudan alışveriş akışına yerleştirerek platform içi üretimi genişletiyor.

Kaynak: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

en.t: Amazon adds AI-designed custom merchandise to its app
en.d: A new Shopping-app feature turns Alexa-generated designs into printed products like T-shirts.
en.body:
Amazon has added a feature that lets users create custom merchandise with AI inside its Shopping app. Shoppers can generate designs through Alexa and print them on products such as T-shirts, hoodies and tumblers. The feature builds personalization directly into the shopping flow, expanding on-platform creation.

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

de.t: Amazon bringt KI-gestaltete Custom-Produkte in seine App
de.d: Eine neue Funktion der Shopping-App druckt mit Alexa erstellte Designs auf Produkte wie T-Shirts.
de.body:
Amazon hat eine Funktion eingeführt, mit der Nutzer in der Shopping-App per KI eigene Produkte gestalten können. Über Alexa erstellte Designs lassen sich auf Artikel wie T-Shirts, Hoodies und Thermobecher drucken. Die Funktion bettet Personalisierung direkt in den Einkaufsprozess ein und erweitert die Erstellung auf der Plattform.

Quelle: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

fr.t: Amazon ajoute des produits personnalisés conçus par IA dans son appli
fr.d: Une nouvelle fonction de l'appli imprime sur des produits les visuels générés via Alexa.
fr.body:
Amazon a ajouté une fonction permettant de créer des produits personnalisés par IA dans son application Shopping. Les utilisateurs peuvent générer des visuels via Alexa et les imprimer sur des articles comme des t-shirts, des sweats et des mugs isothermes. La fonction intègre la personnalisation directement dans le parcours d'achat et étend la création sur la plateforme.

Source : https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

es.t: Amazon suma productos personalizados diseñados con IA en su app
es.d: Una nueva función de la app imprime en productos los diseños generados con Alexa.
es.body:
Amazon ha añadido una función que permite crear productos personalizados con IA dentro de su app de compras. Los usuarios pueden generar diseños a través de Alexa e imprimirlos en artículos como camisetas, sudaderas y vasos térmicos. La función integra la personalización directamente en el flujo de compra y amplía la creación dentro de la plataforma.

Fuente: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

it.t: Amazon aggiunge prodotti personalizzati creati con l'IA nella sua app
it.d: Una nuova funzione dell'app stampa sui prodotti i design generati tramite Alexa.
it.body:
Amazon ha aggiunto una funzione che consente di creare prodotti personalizzati con l'IA nella sua app Shopping. Gli utenti possono generare design tramite Alexa e stamparli su articoli come t-shirt, felpe e borracce termiche. La funzione integra la personalizzazione direttamente nel percorso d'acquisto ed estende la creazione sulla piattaforma.

Fonte: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/amazon-now-lets-you-design-custom-merch-using-ai/

tr.t: 'The Mall' uygulaması online alışveriş için tek akış kuruyor
tr.d: Uygulama; binlerce perakendeciden markaları tek kişiselleştirilmiş akışta topluyor, indirim ve lansmanları takip ediyor.
tr.body:
The Mall adlı yeni uygulama, online alışveriş için 'evrensel bir akış' oluşturmayı hedefliyor. Kullanıcılar markalardan oluşan kişisel bir akış kurabiliyor, indirimleri ve yeni ürün lansmanlarını izleyebiliyor ve binlerce perakendeci arasında ürün keşfedebiliyor. Uygulama, dağınık alışveriş deneyimini tek bir keşif katmanında toplama iddiasında.

Kaynak: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

en.t: New app 'The Mall' builds a universal feed for online shopping
en.d: It gathers brands from thousands of retailers into one personalized feed, tracking sales and drops.
en.body:
A new app called The Mall aims to build a 'universal feed' for online shopping. Users can create a personalized feed of brands, track sales and new-product drops, and discover items across thousands of retailers. The app pitches itself as a single discovery layer over an otherwise fragmented shopping experience.

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

de.t: Neue App 'The Mall' baut einen universellen Feed fürs Online-Shopping
de.d: Sie bündelt Marken aus Tausenden Händlern in einem personalisierten Feed und verfolgt Angebote und Drops.
de.body:
Eine neue App namens The Mall will einen 'universellen Feed' fürs Online-Shopping schaffen. Nutzer können einen personalisierten Marken-Feed anlegen, Angebote und Produkt-Drops verfolgen und Artikel über Tausende Händler hinweg entdecken. Die App versteht sich als einzige Entdeckungsebene über einem sonst fragmentierten Einkaufserlebnis.

Quelle: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

fr.t: La nouvelle appli « The Mall » crée un fil universel pour le shopping en ligne
fr.d: Elle réunit les marques de milliers de détaillants dans un fil personnalisé et suit soldes et sorties.
fr.body:
Une nouvelle application nommée The Mall veut créer un « fil universel » pour le shopping en ligne. Les utilisateurs peuvent constituer un fil personnalisé de marques, suivre les promotions et les sorties de produits, et découvrir des articles parmi des milliers de détaillants. L'appli se présente comme une couche de découverte unique au-dessus d'une expérience d'achat autrement fragmentée.

Source : https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

es.t: La nueva app 'The Mall' crea un feed universal para las compras online
es.d: Reúne marcas de miles de minoristas en un feed personalizado y sigue ofertas y lanzamientos.
es.body:
Una nueva app llamada The Mall busca crear un 'feed universal' para las compras online. Los usuarios pueden montar un feed personalizado de marcas, seguir ofertas y lanzamientos de productos y descubrir artículos entre miles de minoristas. La app se presenta como una única capa de descubrimiento sobre una experiencia de compra por lo demás fragmentada.

Fuente: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

it.t: La nuova app 'The Mall' crea un feed universale per lo shopping online
it.d: Raccoglie i brand di migliaia di rivenditori in un feed personalizzato e segue offerte e uscite.
it.body:
Una nuova app chiamata The Mall punta a creare un 'feed universale' per lo shopping online. Gli utenti possono costruire un feed personalizzato di brand, seguire offerte e lanci di prodotti e scoprire articoli tra migliaia di rivenditori. L'app si propone come un unico livello di scoperta sopra un'esperienza d'acquisto altrimenti frammentata.

Fonte: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

tr.t: Amazon'a rakip lojistik girişimi Stord 250 milyon dolar topladı
tr.d: E-ticaret fulfillment ağı Stord, 3 milyar dolar değerleme ile yatırım aldı.
tr.body:
E-ticaret markaları için depo ağı ve stok yönetim yazılımı sunan Stord, 3 milyar dolarlık değerleme üzerinden 250 milyon dolar yatırım aldı. Şirket kendini 'Amazon karşıtı' olarak konumlandırıyor; markalara rekabet edecek teslimat hızını sunarken müşteri ilişkisinin markada kalmasını vaat ediyor. Yatırım, bağımsız fulfillment altyapısına olan talebin büyüdüğünü gösteriyor.

Kaynak: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/

en.t: Amazon fulfillment rival Stord raises $250M at $3B valuation
en.d: The e-commerce fulfillment network lands fresh funding as demand for independent logistics grows.
en.body:
Stord, which offers a network of warehouses and inventory-management software for e-commerce brands, has raised $250 million at a $3 billion valuation. The company positions itself as a sort of 'anti-Amazon,' giving brands the speed to compete while letting them keep ownership of the customer relationship. The round signals growing demand for independent fulfillment infrastructure.

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/

de.t: Amazon-Rivale Stord sammelt 250 Mio. $ bei 3-Mrd.-Bewertung ein
de.d: Das E-Commerce-Fulfillment-Netzwerk erhält frisches Kapital, da die Nachfrage nach unabhängiger Logistik wächst.
de.body:
Stord, das ein Netzwerk aus Lagern und Software zur Bestandsverwaltung für E-Commerce-Marken bietet, hat 250 Millionen Dollar bei einer Bewertung von 3 Milliarden Dollar eingesammelt. Das Unternehmen versteht sich als eine Art 'Anti-Amazon': Es gibt Marken das Tempo zum Wettbewerb, während sie die Kundenbeziehung behalten. Die Runde zeigt die wachsende Nachfrage nach unabhängiger Fulfillment-Infrastruktur.

Quelle: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/

fr.t: Stord, rival d'Amazon dans la logistique, lève 250 M$ à 3 Md$ de valorisation
fr.d: Le réseau de fulfillment e-commerce obtient de nouveaux fonds alors que la demande de logistique indépendante augmente.
fr.body:
Stord, qui propose un réseau d'entrepôts et un logiciel de gestion des stocks pour les marques e-commerce, a levé 250 millions de dollars pour une valorisation de 3 milliards. L'entreprise se présente comme une sorte d'« anti-Amazon » : elle offre aux marques la rapidité nécessaire pour rivaliser tout en leur laissant la maîtrise de la relation client. Le tour de table témoigne d'une demande croissante d'infrastructures de fulfillment indépendantes.

Source : https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/

es.t: Stord, rival de Amazon en logística, capta 250 M$ con una valoración de 3.000 M$
es.d: La red de fulfillment para e-commerce logra financiación mientras crece la demanda de logística independiente.
es.body:
Stord, que ofrece una red de almacenes y software de gestión de inventario para marcas de e-commerce, ha captado 250 millones de dólares con una valoración de 3.000 millones. La compañía se posiciona como una especie de 'anti-Amazon': da a las marcas la velocidad para competir mientras conservan la relación con el cliente. La ronda evidencia la creciente demanda de infraestructura de fulfillment independiente.

Fuente: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/

it.t: Stord, rivale di Amazon nella logistica, raccoglie 250 mln $ a una valutazione di 3 mld
it.d: La rete di fulfillment per l'e-commerce ottiene nuovi fondi mentre cresce la domanda di logistica indipendente.
it.body:
Stord, che offre una rete di magazzini e software di gestione dell'inventario per i brand e-commerce, ha raccolto 250 milioni di dollari a una valutazione di 3 miliardi. L'azienda si posiziona come una sorta di 'anti-Amazon': dà ai brand la velocità per competere lasciando loro la proprietà della relazione con il cliente. Il round segnala la crescente domanda di infrastrutture di fulfillment indipendenti.

Fonte: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/26/amazon-fulfillment-competitor-stord-raises-250m-at-3b-valuation/
